verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an MCP server hosting and deployment platform, but the evidence describes no cron or time-based scheduler. The automation that is documented is event-triggered or one-off: deploys on push, on-demand deploys, and checklists that run after each successful deployment. None of these is a recurring schedule, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
